senses.gloss: m.(b. h. גֹּבַהּ; גָּבַהּ)height, elevation; thick, fleshy part (cmp. גַּב).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 4:1">Midd. IV, 1</cite> <he>גָּבְהוֹ</he> <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 4:6">Ib. 6</cite>. <he>גּוֹבְהוֹ</he>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Menachot 37b:5">Men. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ שביד</he> the thickest part of the upper arm (<cite ref="S00858"><he>קיבורת</he></cite>); <he>ג׳ שבראש</he> the highest point of the forehead.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:1:17">Y. Yeb. VIII, 9ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 19:6:2">Y. Sabb. XIX, end, 17ᵇ</cite>; Bab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 137b:2">Sabb. 137ᵇ</cite> <he>גּוֹבְהָהּ של עטרה</he> the thickest part of the apex.
